notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36291387/ed898337e4a65f37031c0b5b0ecadf0f4cb39c57.jpg[/img]

Attention all Onion Games fans outside Japan... the time has actually come! 

You can now...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649490/Stray_Children

Wishlist [i]Stray Children[/i], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649490/Stray_Children]right here on Steam[/url]!

That's right! Following its 2024 release on the Nintendo Switch in Japan, we've been hard at work preparing the full English localization for worldwide release. Now, we're happy to announce that the game will be releasing in 2025 on Steam, as well as on Switch!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36291387/950dab02f478facf8200d6f433b04b381cbcd72c.jpg[/img]

Here's a little teaser from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649490/Stray_Children]the Steam page description[/url]: 

Somewhere, in our world, there’s a secret room, in a secret place, filled top to bottom with ancient technology. 

When one young boy flips the switch on a curious old console, they’re suddenly whisked away, through the screen, into a very strange somewhere else: a long-since forgotten role playing game.

Blinking awake in this peculiar new place, they find themselves in a land of children.

Outside this stronghold’s walls lurk The Olders: monstrous adults, carrying the heavy load of their own inadequacies, self-doubt, and all of the grievances that grown-ups gather. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36291387/c9a4824451315ee24d69e36f7e77b71d547df657.jpg[/img]

Rumor has it that these creatures are starving for something, and that — out there — no one and nowhere is safe.

Can you survive in this world where half-crazed adults lurk around every corner?

It’s here — in this funny, mysterious, and wildly dangerous domain — that your story begins.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36291387/5204123456ad21b2424561cd8494fd0ff1649a73.jpg[/img]

We hope you're as excited to enter the world of [i]Stray Children[/i] as we are for you to see it! The best way you can let us know... would be to  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649490/Stray_Children]go wishlist the game right now[/url]!

notes.title: Spooky, kooky and musical shmup Black Bird hatches today
notes.notes:
A strange and inky crow-like creature rampages across the land, burning and killing all. A strange dreamlike world crumbles, and a nonsense vocal chorus summons fresh defenders to the field. Black Bird, latest from Onion Games (Million Onion Hotel, Dandy Dungeon) is a trip. While it arrived a little earlier on Switch, it feels only right that this strange little shmup makes its PC debut today, as it feels a bit like Sega’s old Fantasy Zone if it were directed by 90s Tim Burton. Wrap your head around that as you watch the ferociously fowl trailer below.
